description: She wears an opaque deep plum-purple floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Gold geometric and floral woven borders frame the neckline, bodice, sleeve ends, waist, vertical skirt opening and hem. Round gold clasps with purple centers sit at the neckline sides, and a matching jeweled round ornament centers the belt. The front opening reveals a cream patterned underdress below the waist. A broad cream wrap with gold decoration and plum-gold borders rests around her forearms and hangs at both sides. One plum closed-toe shoe with gold embroidery is visible beneath the skirt. Small earrings are visible; no headgear or weapon appears.
